title: ReceiptResponse
description:
Op 4 response: fiscal data for a successfully-printed receipt.

Three fields (`qr`, `verification_number`, `emarks_count`) were added in spec revisions past
v0.5; they are marked `Option` with `serde(default)` so older HDM firmware still deserialises
without errors.

time.description: Receipt timestamp (milliseconds since Unix epoch, Greenwich time).

fiscal.description: Fiscal receipt number — the legally-binding identifier.

lottery.description: Lottery ticket number associated with the receipt.

prize.description: `0` = no prize, `1` = prize won. (Currently no longer used by the lottery system.)

qr.description: QR-code payload to render on the printed receipt. Added post-v0.5.

emarksCount.description: Number of eMark codes processed. Added post-v0.5. Documented as `string` in spec.

verificationNumber.description: Short alphanumeric verification number (≤13 chars) printed on the receipt. Added post-v0.5.
